criteria.reason: Covers all three pillars and 3a, but pillars 1–2 get one line each; depth falls short of the requested full-system explanation.
Pillar structure and deductibility correct, but wrongly claims tax-free withdrawal and a 14,000 CHF couples' limit.
Clear headers, bullets and plain language suit a newcomer, despite occasionally confusing advice.

factual_errors: 3a payouts are taxed at a special reduced rate, not tax-free, on withdrawal.
No ~14,000 CHF couples' limit exists; the annual maximum (~CHF 7,056 in 2024) applies per individual.
summary: A clearly structured but shallow overview of the Swiss three-pillar system and 3a, with generic decision factors and two factual errors on 3a taxation and contribution limits.
